text:
maria: Heads-up — overnight EU backfill (recompute-agg job) kicked off at 01:15 and we hit sustained egress throttles to S3. Job restarted a few times, backlog ~12M rows. Anyone oncall?

samir: I'm on it. grabbing logs now. seeing repeated 503s from transfer-agent and a bunch of shard reschedules.

elena: Can we reroute EU backfills to a dedicated backfill lane with lower parallelism? We have priority lanes in the console but the reprocess API doesn't expose them.

ashley: We also hit a global egress cap — one large tenant is burning bandwidth. We should enforce per-tenant backfill quota, not just global.

jon: +1. Quick API proposal: add `backfill_profile` to the internal replay endpoint. Values: `fair` | `fast` | `spillover`. `fair` = low concurrency, aggressive backoff, dedupe on.

samir: Example curl to test: `curl -X POST https://internal.replay/api/v1/replay -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"stream":"telemetry_agg","start":"2026-03-18T00:00:00Z","profile":"fair","concurrency":4}'`

maria: UX idea for Console Reprocess: surface a "safety_score" from tenant egress history and auto-suggest `fair` when score < 0.3. Would prevent accidental blasts.

elena: Ops runbook suggestion: 1) pause current EU waves 2) spawn 2 small dedicated workers in eu-west-1 3) resume with `profile=fair`. Who can spin infra?

ashley: I can spin infra but need platform-quotas sign-off for extra instances. @platform-quotas please advise.

platform-quotas: (bot) Request received. Current eu-west GPU headroom: ~18%. Can provision 2 x t3-small workers (non-GPU) for CPU-bound reprocess. Approve? :eyes:

ashley: Approving and launching 2 workers with per-worker concurrency 4. Will tag them `replay-fair-eu`.

samir: Starting a resumed run with `--start-offset 12m --concurrency 4 --dedupe true --profile=fair`. Tail logs: `tail -n 200 /var/log/replay/*.log` — watching for S3 503s.

jon: Also a platform change: default `backfill_profile` should be region-aware. If region headroom < 25% -> default to `fair`. I'll open a tiny RFC for the internal API and a migration plan.

maria: We should add console metrics: queued backfill rows, per-tenant egress bytes, worker pool utilization, and last-successful-offset per-shard. That will make triage much faster.

elena: Agree. Adding a dashboard ticket now. Also add a console hint in Reprocess modal suggesting `fair` when safety_score low.

ashley: Workers up, patch applied, kicking resume. Run id: replay-eu-20260318-01.

samir: Logs look better, 200s instead of 503s. Progress 1.2% -> 5% in 20m. No new restarts.

maria: Great. Action items summary: infra spin (ashley), API flag + RFC (jon), console dashboard + hint (elena), runbook update + monitoring (samir). Target: close today EOD.

elena: Quick UX question — should `fair` be the default in EU for now? Safer to reduce blast risk.

maria: Let's make `fair` default for regions with <25% spare egress headroom. Jon, include that in the RFC.

ashley: Confirm: workers labeled `replay-fair-eu` and autoscaled group set to max 4. Rolling monitor in place.

samir: Recompute holding steady. No S3 503s observed in the last 30m. Progress ~11% now.

maria: Thanks team. @analytics can you run the A1 eval set on the recomputed aggregates once the run completes to validate quality? If we see regressions we can relax `fair` parameters selectively.

analytics: Will run eval A1 after completion and post a short report.

maria: Closing huddle. If anything degrades move this thread to #incidents and tag oncall. :thumbsup:
